Game Overview

At its heart, Flap A Bird 3D is a animal game about guide your bird through a vibrant 3D landscape, avoiding obstacles with each precise tap. Experience the thrill of navigating through dynamically rendered pipes, sans RTX, in a beautifully engaging world. Can you keep your feathered friend in flight and soaring to new heights?
